# @mission-platform/vite-plugin-tokens

A Vite plugin that generates the Mission Platform design-token artefacts from
the DTCG (Design Tokens Community Group, https://www.designtokens.org/) sources
using a self-contained custom generator — no external CLI is involved. The DTCG
sources are flattened in-process and emitted by focused generator modules
(`dtcg.ts`, `generators/scss.ts`, `generators/typescript.ts`); one SCSS partial
and one TypeScript module are produced per source file. Component sources are
discovered recursively, so adding a file under the component source tree does
not require a generator descriptor.

It replaces the previous standalone generation script: the artefacts are
produced during `vite build` (and on dev-server start) via the rollup
`buildStart` hook.

## Inputs

DTCG `*.tokens.json` sources (authored against the **v2025.10** schema):

- `palette.tokens.json`      — primitive colour palette (OKLab `color` tokens)
- structural scales          — one file each: `border-width`, `breakpoint`, `motion` (duration + easing),
  `opacity`, `radius`, `shadow`, `size`, `spacing`, `z-index`
- `font.tokens.json`         — primitive font scales (family, size, weight, line-height, letter-spacing)
- `typography.tokens.json`   — composite `typography`-type styles (display, h1–h6, body-*, label, caption, code);
  each carries the `{font.*}` primitives plus `marginBlock`/`marginInline` `{spacing.*}` logical-margin aliases
- `theme-light.tokens.json`  — light-theme semantic colours (palette `{color.*}` aliases)
- `theme-dark.tokens.json`   — dark-theme semantic colours (palette `{color.*}` aliases)
- `component/{atoms,molecules,organisms,templates}/*.tokens.json` — split visual
  component contracts. The first key below the `component` wrapper is the CSS
  layer namespace (`component.button.*` emits `--mp-button-*`). Shared
  contracts are authored once and reused by composed components.

## Outputs (written to `outDir`)

One SCSS partial per non-theme source (the two themes are merged into one), one
TS module per source, plus two aggregate barrels. Component artifacts preserve
their atomic-level relative path:

- `scss/_<file>.scss`             — a self-contained structural SCSS partial per non-theme source:
  unprefixed `$` variables, then `:root { --mp-*: #{$<token>} }` custom properties (each value
  interpolates the matching local `$`-variable, never an inlined literal), then a matching
  `@property { syntax; inherits; initial-value }` registration per token (typed by `$type`).
  - `palette` is emitted exactly like the structural scales (`$color-*` vars + `--mp-color-*` custom
    properties + `<color>` `@property` registrations); colours with `alpha` (scrims) round-trip too
  - `typography` is flattened to per-field tokens (`typography-<variant>-<field>`) whose value is a
    `var(--mp-font-*)` (or `var(--mp-spacing-*)` for the `margin-block`/`margin-inline` fields) reference
    to the primitive token, then emitted through the same structural path
- `scss/_theme.scss`              — the single combined theme partial:
  `:root { color-scheme: light dark; --mp-color-*: light-dark(<light>, <dark>); }`, where each
  light/dark value is a `var(--mp-color-*)` reference to the matching palette custom property
  (the `theme-light`/`theme-dark` sources hold palette aliases). It also emits the opt-in scheme
  pins `[data-theme='light'], .theme-light { color-scheme: light }` and the matching dark rules
  (after `:root`, inside the `mp.tokens` layer), so importing `scss/tokens` alone is enough to pin a
  subtree (or the document) to one scheme via `data-theme`/`.theme-*`. No `@property` is emitted for
  the theme — `light-dark()`/`var()` are not valid `initial-value`s.
- `ts/<file>.ts`                  — one nested `as const` object per source, named after the file
  (camelCased). A single top-level group whose key equals the file name is unwrapped (so the export
  mirrors the scale directly, e.g. `size.icon.md`); otherwise the document is preserved (`palette.color.*`,
  `font.font.*` / `font['line-height']`, `themeLight.color.*`). Colours are emitted as `oklab(…)` strings
  and both the composite `typography` `{font.*}`/`{spacing.*}` aliases and the `theme-*` `{color.*}` aliases
  are resolved to their primitive values.
- `scss/component/<level>/_<file>.scss` and `_<file>-vars.scss` — component
  partials under the source's atomic level. Their `component.<layer>.*` records
  emit `$<layer>-*`, `--<prefix>-<layer>-*`, and matching `@property` names;
  the `component` wrapper is never included in generated CSS names.
- `ts/component/<level>/<file>.ts` — nested component modules re-exported by
  the TypeScript barrel with collision-safe source-qualified identifiers.
- `_tokens.scss`                  — SCSS barrel `@forward`ing every partial **including** `scss/theme`,
  so a single `@use 'generated/tokens'` emits the structural + palette + typography custom properties
  (with their `@property` registrations), re-exports the `$` variables, and applies the `light-dark()` theme
- `tokens.ts`                     — TypeScript barrel re-exporting every `ts/<file>.ts` module

The generated CSS namespace is not an authoring or override path. Directory and
record overrides continue to address flattened `component.*` DTCG paths; the
legacy aggregate `component` override key remains supported while split sources
are migrated.

Colour values are emitted in the **OKLab** colour space (`oklab(L a b / α)`).

## Post-audit compatibility

The source-driven audit removed 189 unreachable leaves: 185 reviewed candidates and 4 net second-order palette leaves
(6 removed, 2 restored as reachable `.500` leaves) found during alias closure. The deterministic report contains 2,841 leaves (132 active, 2,161 protected, 548
ambiguous, zero candidates), and the package build is the only supported way to regenerate `src/generated`.

The generated TypeScript surface intentionally no longer exports those removed primitive, semantic, typography, or
structural leaves. Retained `component.*` paths, `--mp-<layer>-*`/`$<layer>-*` projections, aliases, and split/legacy
override selectors are unchanged. `color.surface.raised`, `radius.2xs`, and `font.weight.light` remain the only
pre-existing unresolved aliases.

> `@property` registrations use a typed `syntax` for `color`/`dimension`/`number`/`fontWeight`/`duration`
> tokens (with an `initial-value` that resolves to the matching local `$`-variable, e.g.
> `initial-value: $size-radius-2xl;`) and fall back to the universal `*` syntax (no `initial-value`) for
> everything whose value is a `var()` reference (the typography fields) or a non-typeable literal
> (shadows, easing curves, font-family stacks).

## Install

Consumed inside the monorepo as a workspace dependency:

```jsonc
// packages/tokens/package.json
{
  "devDependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/vite-plugin-tokens": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

`vite` is an optional peer dependency.

## Usage

```ts
// packages/tokens/vite.config.ts
import { tokensPlugin } from '@mission-platform/vite-plugin-tokens';
import { defineLibraryConfig } from '@mission-platform/vite-config';

export default defineLibraryConfig({
  rootDir: __dirname,
  entry: 'src/tokens.ts',
  name: 'MissionPlatformTokens',
  preserveModules: false,
  overrides: {
    plugins: [
      tokensPlugin({
        tokensDir: `${__dirname}/tokens`,
        outDir: `${__dirname}/src/generated`,
      }),
    ],
  },
});
```

## API

### `tokensPlugin(options): Plugin`

- `options.tokensDir` — absolute path to the DTCG sources directory. Required.
- `options.outDir` — absolute path where generated artefacts are written. Required.
- `options.prefix` — CSS custom-property prefix. Default `'mp'` (`--mp-*`).

### Helpers (also exported)

- `generateTokens(options)` — run generation outside of Vite.
- `flattenTokens(document)` — flatten a DTCG document into `TokenRecord[]` (path, group, `$type`, value, description).
- `buildScssVariables(records)` — build the grouped, unprefixed `$` SCSS variable body (no header).
- `buildStructuralScss(records, prefix?)` — build a self-contained structural partial (`$`-vars + `:root`
  custom properties that interpolate the local `$`-vars + `@property` registrations). The palette and the
  flattened typography are both emitted through this path.
- `buildLightDarkThemeScss(lightDocument, darkDocument, prefix?)` — build the single combined theme partial
  (`:root { color-scheme: light dark; --<prefix>-color-*: light-dark(<light>, <dark>) }`) plus the opt-in
  `[data-theme]`/`.theme-*` `color-scheme` pins.
- `buildTypographyRecords(typographyGroup, prefix?)` — flatten a composite typography group into per-field
  `TokenRecord`s whose value is the `var(--<prefix>-*)` primitive reference (feed to `buildStructuralScss`).
- `buildPropertyRule(record, prefix, useScssVariable?)` — build a single `@property` registration; with
  `useScssVariable` the `initial-value` resolves to the local `$<token>` instead of an inlined literal.
- `buildTokenModule(basename, document, aliasDocument?)` — build a per-file nested `as const` TS module.
- `buildBarrelModule(basenames)` — build the `tokens.ts` re-export barrel.
- `camelCase(dashed)` / `camelCaseName(record)` — camelCase a dashed string / token name.
- `formatColorValue(value)` / `resolveTsValue(value)` — DTCG → TypeScript value helpers.
- `formatCssColor(value)` / `formatCssValue(value)` — DTCG → CSS/SCSS value helpers.
- `resolveAlias(alias, document)` / `aliasToCssVariable(alias, prefix)` — DTCG alias helpers.
